messages:
Nina Shah: Hey team — need help. Divorce finalized 2026-06-15. I need to remove my ex-spouse from medical/dental/vision and stop spousal HSA contributions. Can removal be retroactive to 2026-04-01 (date of separation) and can premiums from 4/1-6/15 be refunded or credited? Also need COBRA info for them (they're overseas).
Carmen Alvarez: Sorry youre dealing with this, Nina. Short answer: we can request retro removal to 2026-04-01, but carriers often only accept the court finalization date as the official loss-of-coverage. Well need the final divorce decree (court judgment) and any separation agreement you want us to consider. Upload both and well submit a retro request to the carriers and flag payroll.
Nina Shah: I have both — uploaded to the portal (divorce_final_061526.pdf, separation_agreement_040126.pdf). I want to make sure COBRA notices go to the correct address — ex is living abroad now. Can COBRA packet be mailed internationally or emailed?
Carmen Alvarez: Got the uploads, thanks. COBRA varies by carrier: most will mail internationally if you provide an address, but some prefer to email the COBRA packet to the qualified beneficiary. When we submit, please include the exs preferred mailing address and email in the portal comment. Important: COBRA timelines are calculated from the coverage loss date we report to the carrier, so the effective removal date matters for their 60-day election window.
Nina Shah: For payroll implications — if carrier approves retro removal to 4/1 and issues a refund, will that come from payroll or directly from the carrier? Im worried about large one-time credits / deductions.
Payroll Bot: Hi Nina — carriers sometimes issue refunds directly to the subscriber; other times they ask payroll to reconcile. If the carrier issues a refund to you, its separate from payroll. If payroll must credit/deduct, we try to spread adjustments over upcoming pay cycles to avoid big one-offs. We will notify you before any net deduction or credit posts.
Carmen Alvarez: FYI well request both: 1) retro removal/retro effective date to 2026-04-01 and 2) carrier refund or payroll reconciliation for premiums paid during that period. If carrier denies retro effective date, we will process removal effective 2026-06-15 (judgment date) and calculate proration from that date. Expect carrier reply in 1-3 business days.
Nina Shah: Also how do I stop HSA pretax contributions that were directed to spouse coverage? Some contributions were taken while we were still married — do we need to adjust YTD? Any tax forms impacted?
Carmen Alvarez: We can stop pretax HSA contributions immediately. For year-to-date amounts, if contributions were made while they were a covered spouse, generally no correction is needed. Tax reporting (1099-SA/5498/1095 forms) can be affected; Ill loop Benefits Admin to confirm whether additional reporting or corrections are required.
Benefits Admin: Looping in here — please provide payroll/HSA details and any requested retro corrections. Well validate whether a year-to-date adjustment is required and advise on 1095/5498 implications.
Nina Shah: I updated my 401k/life beneficiaries in the portal but dependent life still shows ex as covered. Can you remove dependent life and confirm beneficiaries are processed?
Carmen Alvarez: Dependent life removal follows the same QLE process. Well submit the dependent-life removal along with medical/dental/vision. I see the beneficiary update in the portal — we will confirm with the carrier and the 401k provider. If there's any required signed form for life insurance, well send it to you.
People Ops Bot: Ticket #BP-8340 created for Nina Shah  People Ops will review docs and contact carriers within 2 business days. Status updates will appear in your portal ticket. :white_check_mark:
Payroll Bot: Note: If carrier accepts retro removal and requests payroll reconciliation, Payroll will coordinate netting or scheduled credits. If carrier issues a refund directly, Payroll will not duplicate that refund. We will post a payroll note to your ticket prior to processing.
Carmen Alvarez: Submitted the retro request to carriers and included COBRA mailing preference note. If carrier denies retro effective date well process removal effective 2026-06-15 and calculate proration/refund from that date. Ill post carrier responses here.
Nina Shah: Appreciate it. Also the exs contact info for COBRA: name, email, international postal address provided in portal comments. Thanks for handling the beneficiary confirmations too.
Benefits Admin: Received. Well review HSA/YTD and advise on any tax-reporting steps. Will update the ticket with next steps on 1095/5498/other forms.
Carmen Alvarez: Quick next steps recap: 1) We have the decree + separation agreement. 2) We submitted retro removal request (target date 2026-04-01) and requested carrier refund or payroll reconciliation. 3) COBRA packet request + mailing instructions included. 4) Stopped HSA contributions effective next payroll (pending your confirmation). Well update once carriers reply.
Nina Shah: Thank you all 49a. Please ping me if carriers need anything else.
